- When `stat3_uncalled = {'', 'a1'}` with custom indicator '*', it should set those values to '*'

```
def _indicate_uncalled_modules(statistics: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]],
    stat_name: str, uncalled_modules: Set[str], uncalled_indicator: str='N/A'
    ) ->Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
    out_stats = {name: stat.copy() for name, stat in statistics.items()}
    for mod in uncalled_modules:
        if mod in out_stats:
            out_stats[mod][stat_name] = uncalled_indicator
    return out_stats
```
